parsed.reason: Competent neighbour voice. Quiet and plain-spoken ("I looked up this Sunday"). Specific with facts: names the kids, the activity, the venue, and three concrete reasons (free, outdoor, dry forecast). Short and useful. States plainly what's absent (no registration date) rather than padding. No corporate hype, exclamation marks, or extraneous detail. Leads with the useful thing and only uses the given facts.
